## Tech Stack
- Python 3.10+ (type hints, match statements)
- DSPy (`dspy-ai`) — prompt optimization (post-bootstrap only)
- scipy — statistical tests (Diebold-Mariano, Wilcoxon)
- numpy — CUSUM computation, calibration curve binning
- PyYAML — config file parsing
- pytest — test framework

## Conventions
- All modules under `scripts/kalshi/` — consistent with kalshi-calibration-harness layout
- Domain modules are pluggable classes in `scripts/kalshi/domains/`
- Config files in `config/` — YAML format, no secrets
- Data files in `data/adaptation/` — JSONL format, append-only
- Prompt templates in `config/prompts/vNNN/` — version-tagged directories
- Tests in `test/test_*.py` — mocked, no real API calls

## Architecture Rules
- Two-phase adaptation: manual bootstrap (1-200), then DSPy automated (200+)
- Sequential comparison with CUSUM, not A/B testing (budget constraint)
- Hybrid pipeline: universal calibration core + pluggable domain modules
- Surface expansion ladder: weather → econ → crypto → finance → politics
- 50-prediction gate before expanding to new surface
- Every adaptation is a git commit with before/after metrics
